---
title: "IBGE Dataset Overview"
format: html
editor: visual
---

This code compares census tract boundaries from 2000, 2010, and 2022 in Belo Horizonte. It measures how much the areas overlap and classifies older tracts as stable, reshaped, split, or unmatched. It then visualizes examples of these changes and compares the share of the Black population in 2010 and 2022.

```{r libraries}
#| message: false

library(geobr) # for IBGE's census tracts
library(censobr) # for IBGE's census data
library(tidyverse)
library(mapview)
library(sf)
```

```{r tracts_import}
#| eval: false

# 2000
census_tract_2000_urban <- read_census_tract(
year = 2000,
code_tract = "all",
zone = "urban"
)

census_tract_2000_rural <- read_census_tract(
year = 2000,
code_tract = "all",
zone = "rural"
)


#2010
census_tract_2010 <- read_census_tract(
year = 2010,
code_tract = "all"
)


#2022
census_tract_2022 <- read_census_tract(
year = 2022,
code_tract = "all"
)


# CRS check

st_crs(census_tract_2000_urban) == st_crs(census_tract_2010)
st_crs(census_tract_2000_urban) == st_crs(census_tract_2022)

# save

st_write(census_tract_2000_urban, "ibge_census_tracts.gpkg", layer = "2000_urban")
st_write(census_tract_2000_rural, "ibge_census_tracts.gpkg", layer = "2000_rural")
st_write(census_tract_2010, "ibge_census_tracts.gpkg", layer = "2010")
st_write(census_tract_2022, "ibge_census_tracts.gpkg", layer = "2022")
```

```{r census_data_import}

## 2000
census_data_2000_basico <- read_tracts(
  year = 2000,
  dataset = "Basico",
  as_data_frame = TRUE
)

## 2010
census_data_2010_pessoa <- read_tracts(
  year = 2010,
  dataset = "Pessoa",
  as_data_frame = TRUE
)

## 2022
census_data_2022_basico <- read_tracts(
  year = 2022,
  dataset = "Basico",
  as_data_frame = TRUE
)

census_data_2022_pessoas <- read_tracts(
  year = 2022,
  dataset = "Pessoas",
  as_data_frame = TRUE
)
```

# Census Tract

## Overlap Analysis

```{r compute_intersections}
#| eval: false

## Computationally intensive for whole of Brazil! 
  ## Filtering for Belo Horizonte only


# 2000 vs. 2010
intersections_2000_2010 <- st_intersection(
  
  census_tract_2000_urban %>% 
    filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>% 
    select(code_tract_2000 = code_tract, geometry),
  
  census_tract_2010  %>% 
    filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>% 
    select(code_tract_2010 = code_tract, geometry)
)

# 2000 vs. 2022
intersections_2000_2022 <- st_intersection(
  
  census_tract_2000_urban %>% 
    filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>% 
    select(code_tract_2000 = code_tract, geometry),
  
  census_tract_2022  %>% 
    filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>% 
    select(code_tract_2022 = code_tract, geometry)
)

# save intersecions

st_write(intersections_2000_2010, "bh_intersections.gpkg", layer = "intersections_2000_2010")
st_write(intersections_2000_2022, "bh_intersections.gpkg", layer = "intersections_2000_2022")
```

```{r load_saved_computations}

intersections_2000_2010 <- st_read("bh_intersections.gpkg", layer = "intersections_2000_2010")
intersections_2000_2022 <- st_read("bh_intersections.gpkg", layer = "intersections_2000_2022")
```

### 2000 -\> 2010

```{r tract_change_summary_2000_2010}

intersections_2000_2010 <- intersections_2000_2010 %>%
  mutate(area_intersection = st_area(geom))

tract_areas_2010_bh <- census_tract_2010 %>%
  filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>%
  select(code_tract_2010 = code_tract) %>%
  mutate(area_2010 = st_area(geometry)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

change_summary_2000_2010 <- intersections_2000_2010 %>%
  mutate(area_intersection = st_area(geom)) %>%
  left_join(tract_areas_2010_bh, by = "code_tract_2010") %>%
  mutate(overlap_pct = as.numeric(area_intersection / area_2010)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(code_tract_2000) %>%
  summarise(
    n_2010_tracts          = n(),
    n_2010_tracts_over5pct = sum(overlap_pct > 0.05),
    min_overlap_pct        = min(overlap_pct),
    max_overlap_pct        = max(overlap_pct),
    total_overlap_pct      = sum(overlap_pct),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change_type = case_when(
      n_2010_tracts_over5pct == 1 & max_overlap_pct > 0.95 ~ "stable",
      n_2010_tracts_over5pct == 1                           ~ "reshaped",
      n_2010_tracts_over5pct >  1                           ~ "split",
      TRUE                                                   ~ "unmatched"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(code_tract_2000 = as.character(code_tract_2000))

change_summary_2000_2010 %>% arrange(desc(n_2010_tracts_over5pct))

change_summary_2000_2010 %>% count(change_type)

change_summary_2000_2010 %>% summary()
```

### 2000 -\> 2022

```{r}

tract_areas_2022_bh <- census_tract_2022 %>%
  filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>%
  select(code_tract_2022 = code_tract) %>%
  mutate(area_2022 = st_area(geometry)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

change_summary_2000_2022 <- intersections_2000_2022 %>%
  mutate(area_intersection = st_area(geom)) %>%
  left_join(tract_areas_2022_bh, by = "code_tract_2022", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(overlap_pct = as.numeric(area_intersection / area_2022)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(code_tract_2000) %>%
  summarise(
    n_2022_tracts          = n(),
    n_2022_tracts_over5pct = sum(overlap_pct > 0.05),
    min_overlap_pct        = min(overlap_pct),
    max_overlap_pct        = max(overlap_pct),
    total_overlap_pct      = sum(overlap_pct),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change_type = case_when(
      n_2022_tracts_over5pct == 1 & max_overlap_pct > 0.95 ~ "stable",
      n_2022_tracts_over5pct == 1                           ~ "reshaped",
      n_2022_tracts_over5pct >  1                           ~ "split",
      TRUE                                                   ~ "unmatched"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(code_tract_2000 = as.character(code_tract_2000))

change_summary_2000_2022 %>% arrange(desc(n_2022_tracts_over5pct))
change_summary_2000_2022 %>% count(change_type)
change_summary_2000_2022 %>% summary()
```

### Visualization - Change Types

**Split**

```{r example_1_split}

sector_2000 <- census_tract_2000_urban %>% 
  filter(code_tract == "310620025610001")

# 2010 tract areas
tract_areas_2010_bh <- census_tract_2010 %>%
  filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>%
  select(code_tract_2010 = code_tract) %>%
  mutate(area_2010 = st_area(geometry)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# 2022 tract areas
tract_areas_2022_bh <- census_tract_2022 %>%
  filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>%
  select(code_tract_2022 = code_tract) %>%
  mutate(area_2022 = st_area(geometry)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# 2010 tracts where >5% of THEIR area falls within the 2000 tract
sector_2010_codes <- intersections_2000_2010 %>%
  filter(code_tract_2000 == "310620025610001") %>%
  mutate(area_intersection = st_area(geom)) %>%
  left_join(tract_areas_2010_bh, by = "code_tract_2010") %>%
  mutate(overlap_pct = as.numeric(area_intersection / area_2010)) %>%
  filter(overlap_pct > 0.05) %>%
  pull(code_tract_2010)

# 2022 tracts where >5% of THEIR area falls within the 2000 tract
sector_2022_codes <- intersections_2000_2022 %>%
  filter(code_tract_2000 == "310620025610001") %>%
  mutate(area_intersection = st_area(geom)) %>%
  left_join(tract_areas_2022_bh, by = "code_tract_2022") %>%
  mutate(overlap_pct = as.numeric(area_intersection / area_2022)) %>%
  filter(overlap_pct > 0.05) %>%
  pull(code_tract_2022)

mapview(sector_2000,
        col.regions = "red",
        alpha.regions = 0.4,
        layer.name = "2000 tract") +
mapview(census_tract_2010 %>% filter(code_tract %in% sector_2010_codes),
        col.regions = "orange",
        alpha.regions = 0.4,
        layer.name = "2010 tracts (>5%)") +
mapview(census_tract_2022 %>% filter(code_tract %in% as.character(sector_2022_codes)),
        col.regions = "steelblue",
        alpha.regions = 0.4,
        layer.name = "2022 tracts (>5%)")
```

# Census Data

## Visualization - BH

### Black population ratio

```{r race_ratio_calculation}

## 2010
black_ratio_2010 <- census_data_2010_pessoa %>% 
  mutate(black_ratio = pessoa03_V003/pessoa03_V001) %>% 
  select(code_tract, black_ratio, pessoa03_V001, pessoa03_V003)

black_ratio_2010_sf <- census_tract_2010 %>% 
  mutate(code_tract = as.character(code_tract)) %>% 
  right_join(black_ratio_2010)

(black_ratio_2010_bh <- black_ratio_2010_sf %>% filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>%  st_drop_geometry() %>% select(black_ratio_2010 = black_ratio )) %>% summary()

### Boxplot to check for outliers
boxplot(black_ratio_2010_bh)

## 2020
black_ratio_2022 <- census_data_2022_basico %>% 
  select(code_tract, V0001) %>% left_join(census_data_2022_pessoas %>% select(code_tract, raca_V01318)) %>% 
  mutate(black_ratio = raca_V01318/ V0001)

black_ratio_2022_sf <- census_tract_2022 %>% 
  mutate(code_tract = as.character(code_tract)) %>% 
  right_join(black_ratio_2022)

(black_ratio_2022_bh <- black_ratio_2022_sf %>% filter(name_muni == "Belo Horizonte") %>%  st_drop_geometry() %>% select(black_ratio_2022 = black_ratio )) %>% summary()

### Boxplot to check for outliers
boxplot(black_ratio_2022_bh)
```

```{r import_linha_verde}

library(readr)

linha_verde_bh <- read_sf("infraurbana_viario_linhaverde/infraurbana_viario_linhaverde.shp")
```

```{r visualization_black_ratio}

munis <- c("Belo Horizonte", "Vespasiano", "São José da Lapa", "Confins", "Lagoa Santa", "Santa Luzia")

m2010 <- black_ratio_2010_sf %>% 
  filter(name_muni %in% munis, abbrev_state == "MG") %>% 
  select(pop = pessoa03_V001, black_pop = pessoa03_V003, black_ratio)
  

m2022 <- black_ratio_2022_sf %>% 
  filter(name_muni %in% munis, abbrev_state == "MG") %>% 
  select(pop = V0001, black_pop = raca_V01318, black_ratio) 


breaks <- c(seq(0, 0.45, by = 0.05), Inf)

mapview(m2010, zcol = "black_ratio", na.color = "gray", layer.name = "2010", at = breaks, alpha.regions = 1) +
  mapview(m2022, zcol = "black_ratio", na.color = "gray", layer.name = "2022", at = breaks, alpha.regions = 1) +
  mapview(linha_verde_bh, layer.name = "Metro", color = "green", lwd = 1)
```
